noPlottableNumericResults: There are no numeric results to plot. Failed or unknown samples will not be filled in to form a curve.
discardExperimentEditsAndSwitchPrompt: The experiment draft has unsaved changes. Discard them and switch?
experimentDraftSavedNotice: Experiment draft saved; official worldbuilding is unchanged.
freezeExperimentVersionPrompt: Freeze the current parameters, assumptions, and acceptance rules? Subsequent changes will be saved as new versions without changing previous results.
saveAndConfirmNewVersionFirst: Save your changes and confirm the new version first.
enterValidationQuestionFirst: Enter the question you want to test first.
experimentDraftAcceptedNotice: Accepted as an experiment draft. The author still needs to confirm the acceptance version; Canon has not been changed.
validateAndSaveSeparateDraft: Validate and save as a separate draft
limitedExperimentValidationHint: Define the variables, confirm the premises, then test within limited conditions. Finding no contradictions does not prove that the entire world is coherent.
worldTestingAuthorInterpretation: Test your world and retain your right to interpret it
experimentStartingPointsHint: Start with travel times, event order, resource balances, physical dimensions, or custom logic. You can also describe a question on the right and ask AI to generate an experiment draft.
currentExperimentRuleVersion: Rule version for the current experiment
draftChangesPreservePastAcceptance: Editing the draft will not change past acceptance decisions.
experimentValidationQuestionPrompt: What do I want to test?
socialEconomicModelLimitsHint: Social or economic experiments test only explicitly accepted quantitative relationships; results remain unknown when no reliable model is available.
selectedSourcesEvidenceNotice: Reference materials, plans, and unknown states do not automatically become facts. Only sources explicitly selected on the right will be sent to AI.
selectExistingSettingCharacterOrEvent: Select an existing setting, character, or event…
explicitAuthorExperimentDefinition: Explicitly defined by the author in the experiment
unknownParametersAndSolverVariablesHelp: Leave unknown parameters blank. Use English units, such as km, hour, kg, joule, or credit. Variables to solve for are used only by Z3 and are not established facts.
calculationGoalPrompt: What would you like to calculate?
parameterScanSampleLimit: Scan one parameter using the current formulas (up to 32 samples)
experimentPassCriteriaPrompt: How should we determine whether the experiment passes?
versionLockAndPassMeaningNotice: Confirmation locks the version. PASS only means the acceptance checks that were run passed; qualitative judgments still require author review.
eventDependencyCycleCheckHelp: Check whether explicit event dependencies contain a directed cycle.
solverDecidable: Can be determined by the solver
unconfirmedChangesRunNotice: The current changes have not been saved and confirmed. The experiment will not run using the previous acceptance version.
syntaxPassedMathNotChecked: Format and syntax passed; mathematical acceptance checks were not run.
feasibleCounterexampleNotice: Feasible counterexample (experiment variables, not new story facts)
aiReviewSeparateFromDeterministicResults: AI review feedback (separate from deterministic results)
advancedSolverVersionAndRawReport: Advanced · Solver, version, and raw report
counterfactualBaselineCopyHelp: Copy the inputs from the confirmed Baseline and retain the original acceptance rules. Confirm the new plan again; the original settings will never be changed.
selectExecutedReport: Select a report from a completed run
declarativeDataOnlyNotice: Only declarative data is accepted. Python, Shell, dynamic scripts, and arbitrary functions are prohibited.
experimentIdChangeRestriction: The experiment ID cannot be changed; use import or copy instead.
validatedAndLoadedUnsavedNotice: Validated and loaded into the editor; not yet saved or confirmed.
aiProposalAndLocalSolverExplanation: AI proposes plans and acceptance conditions; the local solver performs the actual mathematical calculations.
designExperimentAndAskNecessaryQuestions: Design an experiment and ask necessary follow-up questions
populationArmyRequirementsExample: With a population of five million and a standing army of eight hundred thousand, what additional financial and logistical conditions are needed? Do not invent unknown parameters.
currentMaterialSharingScope: Materials to send for this request
explicitlySelectedSourcesScopeFragment: + Explicitly checked sources. Does not include the entire novel or all Canon.
sendSelectedMaterialsAndGenerateProposal: Send selected materials and generate Proposal
authorAnswersAndDemoParametersHelp: Provide your own answers, or leave unknown / skip. Demo parameters must be explicitly accepted.
inspectCompleteExperimentDesignDraft: Inspect the complete experiment design draft
experimentContextAndStateIsolationNotice: This is the author's experiment view and does not enter Writer Context. Experiments do not modify characters, Knowledge, the timeline, Canon, State, or Final.
unsupportedSimulationAndUnknownResultsNo: Python extensions, random simulations, 2D collisions, and multi-agent simulations are not enabled in this version. Unknown solver results are never shown as passing.
cloudMaterialsAndSharingPrivacyNotice: Cloud AI receives the materials you select. Shared templates clear inputs and setting references by default; when sharing reports, you still need to check whether calculation results are private.
enhMappingNotice: Review meaning, variables and sources before freezing. This does not create HARD Canon.
enhStoryClockNotice: Compare declared story times only. Exact timestamps need an offset. Ambiguous dates stay unknown; narrative order is not chronology.
enhScheduleNotice: Use declared capacities, durations and prerequisites only. Times must be integer ticks; no automatic rounding.
enhTraceNotice: Expressions, inputs and results come from the solver record. AI opinions are separate.
enhUnsatCoreNotice: This is an unsatisfiable constraint core, not a proven minimum core. Check whether the formalization represents the literary setting.
enhCompareNotice: Choose actual run reports. Different acceptance criteria or unrelated baselines are explicitly flagged.
enhSameAcceptance: The same frozen acceptance criteria are used
enhDifferentAcceptance: Acceptance criteria differ; do not rank the results directly
enhBaselineVerified: Baseline version and linkage integrity checked
enhBaselineNotLinked: Reports are not linked to the same baseline, or integrity is unconfirmed
enhStrength_extreme: Extreme: challenge boundaries and weak premises
enhStrengthNotice: Intensity never changes thresholds. Multiple roles of one model are not independent scientific evidence.
enhSameModelNotice: AI qualitative opinion, not a solver proof.
enhConfirmCounterexample: Create a separate counterexample draft? It will not run or change the baseline. Review and freeze it first.
enhConfirmWorldProposal: Save a separate PENDING candidate for the selected setting? The original and Canon stay unchanged.
enhWorldProposalSaved: Review candidate created; original setting unchanged.
enhTemplate_author_gravity: Motion and energy under author-defined gravity
